rules.description: Maintained songs need one free action each round. If the Bard cannot take that free action (including paralysis or unconsciousness), the maintained effects end.
One maintained song at a time unless the Bard's Medley feature increases the limit.
Normal songs can be cast while a maintained song runs. A normal song requiring concentration can coexist, but blocks beginning another song until concentration ends.
A creature departing the maintained song's range retains the effect until the beginning of its next turn.
At the start of the Bard's turn, the Bard may change the targets of a maintained song that has a target-count limit, immediately ending its effect on previous targets.
For maintained songs requiring a save, the target saves every round until it fails; thereafter the ongoing effect remains until its duration ends or it is dismissed.
Against a target with spell resistance, the Bard retries a caster level check each round until successful; later rounds of the same song do not repeat that check.
Beginning a song provokes attacks of opportunity and uses concentration-interruption rules like spells.
